# CLI-Anything reference note

The full teacher-provided `CLI-Anything-main.zip` was used as the engineering reference for this package.
This final package keeps a lightweight reference note instead of duplicating the full repository, because the actual deliverable is the `agent-harness/cli_anything/medai` wrapper.

Implemented CLI-Anything-style elements:

- `agent-harness/setup.py`
- `cli_anything/medai/medai_cli.py`
- `cli_anything/medai/core/*`
- `cli_anything/medai/skills/SKILL.md`
- `agent-harness/tests/test_imports.py`
- machine-readable JSON output for every command
